item.title: WWE programming moves to Netflix in Cambodia, France, Belgium, Philippines, and South Korea starting today
item.description: WWE is now available on Netflix for fans residing in Cambodia, France, Belgium, Philippines, and South Korea starting today, January 1, 2026. The moves comes after WWE’s media rights deal with broadcasters in those countries expired at the stroke of midnight on December 31, 2025 and Netflix automatically took over. item.title: Collision rating for 12/25/2025
item.description: Collision on Christmas Day drew 217,000 viewers, down 116,000 viewers from the prior episode. This was one of the least-watched episodes for an AEW show but it was expected considering it fell on the holiday. The show had a 0.04 rating in 18-49, down 0.01 from the previous episode. (Ratings credit: Programming Insider) The post Collision rating for 12/25/2025 appeared first on Wrestling-Online.com.
